items.evidence_quote: He was only a shepherd, but he was not afraid.
items.note: 牧人として tyrant に勇敢に抗議しています。

items.evidence_quote: “You kill people without asking if they did anything wrong!”
items.note: 疑いだけで人を殺す支配者として描かれています。

items.evidence_quote: His friend, who was secretly a wizard, laughed. “I made all of this happen,” he said.
items.note: 友人が秘密の魔法使いで出来事を仕組んだという展開が、相互信頼の核を損なっています。

items.evidence_quote: “My guards will kill you too,” said the ruler.
items.note: 抗議したメロスに支配者が死刑を告げています。

items.evidence_quote: “Give me three days,” he said. “I promise to return.”
items.note: 妹の結婚式に行く三日間、友人が人質として残ります。

items.evidence_quote: Three men blocked the road. Melos drew the golden sword and killed all three.
items.note: 川と襲撃者は登場しますが、遅延や消耗につながりません。

items.evidence_quote: He did not feel weak at all, and he never doubted for a moment.
items.note: 疲れ果てて諦めかける場面がなく、むしろ弱さも疑いもなかったとされています。

items.evidence_quote: He did not feel weak at all, and he never doubted for a moment.
items.note: 友人への信頼で決意を取り戻す展開がなく、初めから一度も疑いません。

items.evidence_quote: He crossed the city wall in a single jump. A dragon guarded the square, and Melos killed it before the crowd.

items.evidence_quote: “You kill people without asking if they did anything wrong!” he shouted.
